description: The file is a Java source file defining the UserService class, which manages user registration, authentication, profile updates, password management, and account locking mechanisms within a book tracking application.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class that handles user account operations such as registration, login, profile management, password changes, and account locking.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles the registration of a new user, including validation, role assignment, password encoding, and automatic authentication.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Creates a new User object with default roles and encoded password.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user from the security context.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all users (primarily for testing or administrative purposes).

methods.name: findUserById
methods.description: Finds a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: findUserByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs authentication for a given User object by username and password.

methods.name: isEmailInUse
methods.description: Checks whether an email is already associated with an existing user.

methods.name: changeUserEmail
methods.description: Allows a user to change their email after validating current password and ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: isPasswordStrengthVeryStrong
methods.description: Checks whether a password meets the strength criteria (based on ZXCVBN score).

methods.name: isPasswordTooWeak
methods.description: Determines if a password is below the required strength threshold.

methods.name: changeUserPassword
methods.description: Updates a user's password after strength validation and encodes it.

methods.name: deleteUserById
methods.description: Deletes a user along with associated data, handling predefined shelves and book deletion.

methods.name: passwordIsIncorrect
methods.description: Checks if a given password does not match the current user's password.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelfFromUserBooks
methods.description: Removes predefined shelves association from books owned by the user.

methods.name: increaseFailAttempts
methods.description: Increments failed login attempts for a user.

methods.name: resetFailAttempts
methods.description: Resets a user's failed login attempt counter.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a user account and records lock time.

methods.name: hoursUntilUnlock
methods.description: Calculates remaining lock time in hours.

methods.name: unlockWhenTimeExpired
methods.description: Unlocks the account if lock duration has expired.
